title: Mark Goyder, who founded Tomorrow's Company, on Arkaro Insights — how agency theory cut the three-legged stool down to one leg
summary: Goyder's 1995 RSA inquiry shaped the enlightened shareholder value clause in the UK Companies Act 2006 and the first investor stewardship code. In a 52-minute episode on why corporate lifespans are collapsing, he reaches for the book's three-legged stool to describe what agency theory removed. He gave the opening talk at the Drucker Forum's India Way session days earlier.
blockquote: Two donkeys and fiduciary duty: why owning a living thing creates a duty to it, and how agency theory reduced Eric Ries’s three-legged stool to the single leg of shareholder value.
